dragonlord_intro:
Welcome, Hero. I am the
Dragonlord. I have been
waiting for thee.

I am the master of these
lands, ruler of all darkness.

If thou wilt join me, I will
give unto thee half of the
world.

What sayest thou? Wilt thou
take my offer?
dragonlord_yes:
Truly? Then the world is
ours! But first, sleep a
while...

Gwahahaha! Thy quest ends
in eternal darkness!
dragonlord_no:
Foolish boy! Thy refusal
shall cost thee thy life!

Come, feel the power of
the Dragonlord!

erdricks_tablet:
I am Erdrick and thou art
my descendant.

Three items hast thou need
of to reach the Castle of
the Dragonlord.

I shall relate to thee
their hiding places.

The first is the Stone of
Sunlight, which can be
found in Tantegel Castle.

The second is the Staff of
Rain, kept in a shrine
north-west of Kol. Its sage
wants the Silver Harp.

The third is Erdrick's Token,
buried in the swamp 69
leagues south and 40 leagues
east of Tantegel Castle.

Take all three to the shrine
far to the south of Rimuldar
to receive the Rainbow Drop.

Go now, my descendant, and
bring peace back to Alefgard.

npcs.old_man_shop:
Garin, a wandering minstrel of
legendary fame, is said to have
built this town.
npcs.old_man_sw:
Many believe that Princess
Gwaelin is hidden away in a cave.
npcs.soldier_middle:
I have heard of one named
Nester. Dost thou know such one?
npcs.man_middle:
It is said that the Princess
was kidnapped and taken eastward.
npcs.woman_middle:
Welcome to Garinham. May
thy stay be a peaceful one.
npcs.man_north_locked:
Behind this dark building
lies the tomb of Garin. But
thou must have a key to pass.

npcs.tomb_sage:
Thou hast braved the dark
tomb. Take this Silver Harp
of Garin. Its music draws
monsters near.

princess_gwaelin_rescue:
Ah! I have waited so long
for this day!

Thou hast saved me! I am
Gwaelin, daughter of King
Lorik.
npcs.princess_gwaelin_no:
But... I love thee so!
Please say thou dost love
me!
npcs.princess_gwaelin_yes:
I am so happy! Let us
return to Tantegel Castle
at once.

npcs.guard_left:
East of this castle is a town
where armor, weapons, and many
other items may be purchased.
Return to the Inn if thou art
wounded. Sleep heals all.
npcs.guard_right:
If thou hast collected all the
Treasure Chests, a key will be
found. Once used, the key will
disappear, but the door will be
open and thou may pass through.
npcs.man_courtyard:
There was a time when
Brecconary was a paradise.
Then the Dragonlord's minions
came.
npcs.woman_courtyard:
Where oh where can I find
Princess Gwaelin?
npcs.merchant_sw_1:
We are merchants who have
traveled much in this land.
Many of our colleagues have
been killed by servants of
the Dragonlord.
npcs.merchant_sw_2:
Rumor has it that entire towns
have been destroyed by the
Dragonlord's servants.
npcs.man_west:
To become strong enough to
face future trials thou must
first battle many foes.
npcs.guard_northeast:
Thou must have a key to
open a door.
npcs.guard_cave:
When entering the cave, take
with thee a torch.
npcs.guard_alcove:
Where oh where can I find
Princess Gwaelin?
npcs.old_man_southeast:
Hero's coming was foretold by
legend. May the light shine
upon this brave warrior.
npcs.old_man_mp_restore:
When thy Magic Points are
low, come back to me. I
shall restore them.

king_lorik_intro:
Descendant of Erdrick, listen
now to my words. It is told
that in ages past Erdrick fought
demons with a Ball of Light.

Then came the Dragonlord who
stole the precious globe and
hid it in the darkness.

Now, Hero, thou must help us
recover the Ball of Light and
restore peace to our land.
The Dragonlord must be defeated.

Take now whatever thou may find
in these Treasure Chests to aid
thee in thy quest.

Then speak with the guards, for
they have much knowledge that
may aid thee.

May the light shine upon
thee, Hero.
king_lorik_save:
I am greatly pleased that thou
hast returned, Hero.

Wilt thou tell me now of thy
deeds so they won't be forgotten?
tantegel-castle-2f.king_lorik_farewell:
Goodbye now, Hero. Take care
and tempt not the Fates.
tantegel-castle-2f.king_lorik_scrolls:
Thy deeds have been recorded
on the Imperial Scrolls of Honor.
tantegel-castle-2f.king_lorik_continue:
Dost thou wish to continue
thy quest?

npcs.guard_patrol:
Dost thou know about
Princess Gwaelin?
npcs.guard_patrol_no:
Half a year now hath passed
since the Princess was kidnapped
by the enemy. Never does the
King speak of it, but he must
be suffering much. Hero,
please save the Princess.
npcs.guard_stairs_bottom:
If thou art planning to take
a rest, first see King Lorik.
npcs.guard_stairs_top:
King Lorik will record thy
deeds in his Imperial Scroll
so thou may return to thy
quest later.
npcs.chancellor:
The King is deeply worried
about Princess Gwaelin. She
was taken by monsters.

npcs.basement_sage:
Thou hast found me! I guard
the Stone of Sunlight. Take
it, descendant of Erdrick!

npcs.man_entrance:
Thou art most welcome
in Brecconary.
npcs.woman_armory:
Welcome! Enter the shop and
speak to its keeper across
the desk.
npcs.old_man_armory:
Watch thy Hit Points
when in the Poisonous Marsh.
npcs.man_inn:
Go north to the seashore, then
follow the coastline west until
thou hath reached Garinham.
npcs.soldier_middle:
Art thou the descendant
of Erdrick? Hast thou
any proof?
npcs.woman_east_inn: No, I am not Princess Gwaelin.
npcs.man_east_shop:
Within sight of Tantegel Castle
to the south is Charlock, the
fortress of the Dragonlord.
npcs.guard_east:
See King Lorik when thy
experience levels are raised.
npcs.old_man_east: If thou art cursed, come again.
npcs.man_magic:
There is a town where magic
keys can be purchased.
npcs.soldier_town:
Many have been the warriors
who have perished on this quest.
But for thee I wish success,
Hero.
npcs.merchant_north:
Please, save us from the
minions of the Dragonlord.
npcs.soldier_northeast:
Beware the bridges! Danger
grows when thou crosses.
npcs.guard_inn:
Tell King Lorik that the
search for his daughter hath
failed. I am almost gone....

npcs.gatekeeper:
This is Cantlin, the walled
city. We built these walls
to keep out the terrible
monsters.
npcs.scholar:
Erdrick's armor is hidden
somewhere in the ruined town
of Hauksness. It was buried
behind a shop.
npcs.merchant:
I sell the finest shields
and armor in all of Alefgard!
The Flame Sword is also
available here.
npcs.old_man:
To create the Rainbow Bridge,
thou wilt need the Stone of
Sunlight, the Staff of Rain,
and the Sacred Amulet.

npcs.old_man_entrance: This is the village of Kol.
npcs.woman_middle:
Please, save us from the
minions of the Dragonlord.
npcs.man_middle:
Dreadful is the South Island.
Great strength and skill and wit
only will bring thee back
from that place.
npcs.guard_middle:
Golem is afraid of the music
of the flute, so 'tis said.
npcs.soldier_armory:
East of Hauksness there is a
town, 'tis said, where one may
purchase weapons of extraordinary
quality.
npcs.old_man_armory:
In legends it is said that
fairies know how to put
Golem to sleep.
npcs.soldier_bath:
Hast thou seen Nester? I
think he may need help.
npcs.old_man_nw:
Though thou art as brave as thy
ancestor, Hero, thou cannot
defeat the great Dragonlord with
such weapons. Thou shouldst
come here again.
npcs.man_west:
Art thou the descendant
of Erdrick? Hast thou any proof?
npcs.guard_sw:
Rimuldar is the place
to buy keys.
npcs.girl_bath:
Have you heard of the Fairy
Flute? Someone lost it
near the village bath.

npcs.townsman_entrance:
This is Rimuldar, the city
of water. We are famous
for selling Magic Keys.
npcs.key_shop_keeper:
Welcome! I sell Magic Keys.
They are 16 gold coins
each. How many wilt thou buy?
npcs.prophetic_man:
Over the western sea lies
a holy shrine. An old sage
lives there, waiting for
someone with a special harp.
npcs.innkeeper:
Resting here costs 50 gold.
Wilt thou stay the night?
npcs.woman_nw:
To the south lies a sacred
shrine where the Staff of
Rain is safely kept.
